entries.title: Reference design locked
entries.body: Hybrid morphology: a humanoid head and arms on a practical wheeled base. Full biped is optional and late. The Sense Head is the first physical subsystem so the body can experience a room before it tries to walk.

entries.title: Phase 1 parts list published
entries.body: Strong-tier Sense Head bill of materials, roughly $1,100 to $1,800 USD at mid-2026 maker prices. Jetson-class compute, depth camera, bus servos, hardware e-stop. Raspberry Pi 5 8GB is the documented fallback if Jetson is scarce.

entries.title: Public guide launched
entries.body: HumanBotty is a public maker guide at humanbotty.jonbailey.xyz. It is a recipe for building a body for an AI you already talk to. It is not a private build diary and it is not AetherOS.

entries.title: Sense Head software published
entries.body: Phase 1 ROS 2 package humanbotty_sense_head is MIT at github.com/Pitchfork-and-Torch/HumanBotty under software/. Safety supervisor sits on the motor path. Look-at-face and look-at-sound are local policies. Tests run without ROS.
